categories.main_business_segments: BEAUTY GARAGE Inc. operates three main business segments: (1) Merchandise Sales, which includes the direct sale of beauty equipment, cosmetics, and consumables to professional salons via e-commerce, showrooms, and catalogs; (2) Store Design, providing design, construction, and renovation services for salons and related businesses; and (3) Other Peripheral Solutions, offering a range of support services such as real estate brokerage, financing, IT systems, insurance, and business consulting for salon owners.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technology is its proprietary B2B e-commerce platform, 'BEAUTY GARAGE Online Shop,' which integrates with in-house developed inventory and logistics management systems to enable efficient, rapid order fulfillment. The company also leverages digital marketing, SaaS-based solutions for salon e-commerce, and a network of logistics centers for same-day shipping. Store design services are supported by in-house and group expertise in interior design and project management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are professional beauty salons, including hair salons, esthetic salons, nail salons, eyelash salons, and increasingly, clinics, fitness gyms, and acupuncture/massage clinics. The company targets business owners and operators in the beauty and wellness industry, providing both products and comprehensive business support services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in Japan, with a nationwide network of showrooms and logistics centers. It also has subsidiaries and business activities in Singapore, Malaysia, and Vietnam, with a focus on expanding its presence in Asia. Over 90% of revenue is generated from the Japanese market.
categories.supply_chain_position: BEAUTY GARAGE operates as a midstream and downstream player, acting as a direct distributor between manufacturers (both domestic and international) and end-user salons, bypassing traditional wholesalers. It also develops and sells its own original brands and manages logistics and fulfillment in-house.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on strengthening its position as the leading B2B platform for the beauty industry through digital transformation, expanding product lineups, enhancing logistics capabilities, and developing new business areas such as SaaS solutions and services for adjacent industries (e.g., fitness, acupuncture). Sustainability, including recycling initiatives and digitalization to reduce environmental impact, is also a key theme. There is no significant traditional R&D, but ongoing investment in IT, logistics, and service innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from the sale of beauty equipment, cosmetics, and consumables to professional salons via e-commerce and physical showrooms. Additional revenue streams include store design and construction fees, real estate brokerage commissions, SaaS and IT service fees, insurance and financial services, and other business support solutions. The company also earns income from original brand products and used equipment sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While there are competitors in each individual business area (e.g., beauty product wholesalers, salon design firms, IT service providers), BEAUTY GARAGE claims a unique position as an integrated B2B platform offering one-stop solutions for salons. It is the market leader in B2B beauty e-commerce in Japan, with no direct competitor matching its breadth of services and digital platform scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, consolidated net sales reached 33.7 billion yen (up 13.0% year-on-year), with operating profit of 1.59 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 1.02 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady double-digit revenue growth over the past five years, with a strong balance sheet and ongoing investments in logistics and digital infrastructure. Employee count is over 400 on a consolidated basis.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: BEAUTY GARAGE differentiates itself by offering a comprehensive, one-stop platform for salon business owners, combining a vast product selection, competitive pricing, rapid delivery, and a suite of business support services (from store design to IT, finance, and education). Its direct-to-salon model eliminates middlemen, improving efficiency and cost. The company emphasizes digital convenience, integrated solutions, and industry expertise as key value drivers.
